title: 第25章 内战第26章 真巧
content_zh:
嘴里虽然说睡一会，可艾什抱着胳膊靠在座位上紧盯过来的骑手们，巴尼看艾什不是很想说话的样子，便自己清了清嗓子，对奔袭而来的骑手们扶胸行李朗声道：
“感谢各位.....英~~~雄们的帮助！
如果没有你们，我们可能现在已经被这群恶心的小东西杀死了。”
三个骑手勒紧缰绳，为首骑着棕色高头大马的骑手原地转了两圈，那骑手掀开兜帽，下拉蒙在脸上的方巾，男人英朗的面貌展露出来。
男人跳下马，调整了下头顶戴的草叶模样的银头冠，褐色的长发披在肩上，两个麻花小辫上挂着金发箍，尖细修长的耳朵抖动中，镶嵌绿水晶或是晶石的耳环晃了下艾什的眼睛。
他眉毛淡泊，鼻翼同样稍微凹陷可鼻梁却高高挺起，有些发白的嘴唇咀嚼两下，扭头向地面吐了一口沾染口水的砂砾。
艾什认不出眼前的男人是哪一种类型的精灵，又或者是许多长耳朵种族中的一支，她保持着不动，看着男人把右手按在左腰上的优雅半弯刀之上。
“从巨木林堡来的？”
男人的帝国语带着很值得口音，嗓音也很沙哑，呼噜呼噜的声音听起来像是灌了一嗓子沙子，他并没有看巴尼，而是盯着兜帽中艾什的双眼，默默握紧了刀柄。
巴尼张开双臂原地转了一圈，两手又对向马车谄媚的笑着说：
“当然，先生，我叫做巴尼.芭芭菈.巴拉克拉克，是名吟游诗人，这位是艾什戴薇尔.弗洛斯特小姐，我们打算去截流镇。”
“我没有问你话，人类先生，我问的是那个蛇瞳的女人，摘下你的兜帽，小姐。”
艾什稍稍昂起脸，她犹豫着要不要摘下兜帽，她不确定眼前的家伙是不是另一伙儿劫匪，所以没有动作上的变化。
男人稍微压下了眉毛，他身边的两个骑手举起了弓瞄准艾什，银色的箭头在阳光下闪耀着亮光。
巴尼一看对方并不是想要好好聊的样子，赶紧举起双手露出职业的假笑。
“喔！
喔！
喔！
先生们，我们有什么话不能静下心来慢慢说呢？我们的马车里有不错的葡萄酒，我们为什么不......”
“闭嘴！

吟游诗人！
这里没有你这个异族张口聒噪的权利！”
男人左边的兜帽骑手呵斥出声，女人的声音清朗又严厉，艾什看看被喝住还想说什么的巴尼，自己咳嗽一声暗示巴尼不要说下去了。
她轻轻摘掉兜帽，露出她满头的柔顺银发，玫瑰色的眼睛内，蛇瞳稍微收缩又放开，她不自觉的将右手摸向左手臂上的骨索。
“我摘下兜帽了，对我朋友友善些，他胆子很小。”
艾什冷声说着从马车上走下，她紧盯那为首的男人，昂起自己的下巴，计算着如果自己突然出手，有没有可能拦住对方射来的箭矢，自己有没有机会可以利用骨索一瞬间切掉他们三个人的脑袋。
男人也同样盯着艾什的蛇瞳，他缓慢的抽出半弯刀，那刀身为直刀，一半刀身到刀尖上翘的刀具，艾什从未见过，帝国人用的长剑都是直的，或许这是异族用的武器。
艾什眨了两下眼，暗笑自己在这种麻烦的时候还能去想无关紧要的事，她皱了皱眉，右手从左手臂上抽出骨索一端，随时准备动手前先叫一嗓子影响对方，不过男人倒是先开了口。
“白发，红瞳，如果你不是血族的吸血鬼，林中孤僻的女妖，你身上没有人类该有的心跳和呼吸，说不准，你有可能是和南方叛军首领有关系的人了。”
艾什有点发懵，白发红瞳在这个世界......应该很常见的好吧，自己怎么就和叛军首领有关系了？她耸了耸肩，保持双手环胸的动作温柔笑笑，以平缓的声音说：
“这位先生，我不太明白您说的是什么意思，我只是个普通的旅者，您说的叛军还有首领，我不清楚。”
男人正欲开口，他左边的人摘下了兜帽，一头亮金色发色的长耳女人放下弓，从马鞍上扯下麻绳，于腰间拔出短弯刀，倒竖细眉气势汹汹的走向艾什说道：
“纳尔萨斯，不用和这个异族女人多说！
我们不能放过任何白发红瞳的人！”
“等一下！
特薇娜！
我们和叛军不同的地方你忘了吗？！”
为首叫纳尔萨斯的男人冷声叫住要来捆绑艾什的女人，艾什也正好能趁机看那女人的长相。
很无趣的白金长发，如同瀑布般披在身后直到腰际，长发尽头由一条绿色带绑了个小马尾，特薇娜金色的细眉抖动两下，让她像是宝石一般的绿眼睛和纳尔萨斯很相像。
content_en:
Although he said to sleep for a while, Ash folded his arms and leaned on the seat to stare closely at the riders coming over. Barney saw that Ash didn't want to talk, so he cleared his throat and said loudly to the riders who were coming, holding their chests and luggage:
"Thank you... heroes for your help!
Without you, we might have been killed by these disgusting little things by now. "
The three riders tightened their reins and led the rider on the tall brown horse to spin twice. The rider lifted his hood and pulled down the scarf covering his face, revealing the man's handsome face.
The man jumped off the horse and adjusted the silver tiara that looked like a blade of grass on his head. His long brown hair was draped over his shoulders. There were blond hair hoops hanging on the two braids. His long and pointed ears were shaking, and earrings inlaid with green crystals or spar dazzled Ash's eyes.
His eyebrows were indifferent, the wings of his nose were also slightly sunken, but the bridge of his nose was raised high. He chewed twice on his somewhat white lips, turned his head and spat out a mouthful of saliva-stained gravel on the ground.
Ash couldn't identify what type of elf the man in front of her was, or one of the many long-eared races. She remained still and watched as the man placed his right hand on the elegant semi-scimitar on his left waist.
"Come from Timber Forest?"
The man's Imperial dialect had a worthy accent, and his voice was very hoarse. His snoring sounded like he had swallowed sand. He did not look at Barney, but stared at Ash's eyes in the hood, silently clenching the handle of the knife.
Barney opened his arms and spun around in a circle, then faced the carriage with both hands and said with a flattering smile:
"Of course, sir, my name is Barney Barbara Baraklak, and I am a bard. This is Miss Ashdevil Frost. We plan to go to Jieliu Town."
"I'm not asking you, Mr. Human. I'm asking the woman with snake eyes. Take off your hood, miss."
Ash raised her face slightly, and she hesitated to take off her hood. She was not sure if the guys in front of her were another group of robbers, so there was no change in her movements.
The man lowered his eyebrows slightly, and the two riders beside him raised their bows and aimed at Ash, the silver arrows shining brightly in the sun.
When Barney saw that the other party didn't want to have a good chat, he quickly raised his hands and showed a professional fake smile.
"Oh!
Oh!
Oh!
Gentlemen, what can't we say slowly and calmly? We have nice wine in the carriage, why don't we..."
"Shut up!
Bard!
You, a foreigner, don't have the right to make noise here! "
The hooded rider on the left of the man scolded, and the woman's voice was clear and stern. Ash looked at Barney who was about to say something after being drunk, and coughed himself to signal Barney to stop talking.
She gently took off her hood, revealing her silky silver hair. In her rose-colored eyes, the snake pupils shrank and opened slightly. She unconsciously touched the bone cord on her left arm with her right hand.
"I took my hood off to be nice to my friend, he's very timid."
Ash said coldly and got off the carriage. She stared closely at the leading man, raised her chin, and calculated whether it would be possible to block the arrows fired by the other party if she suddenly took action, and whether she would have a chance to use the bone rope to cut off the heads of the three of them in an instant.
The man also stared at Ash's snake eyes. He slowly drew out the semi-scimitar. The blade was straight and half of the blade was upturned from the blade to the tip. Ash had never seen it before. The long swords used by the Empire were all straight. Maybe this was a weapon used by aliens.
Ash blinked twice, laughing to herself that she could still think about unimportant things in such a troublesome time. She frowned, and pulled out one end of the bone cord from her left arm with her right hand, ready to shout to influence the other person before taking action, but the man spoke first.
"White hair, red eyes, if you are not a vampire of the vampire family, in the forestLonely banshee, you don't have the heartbeat and breathing that a human should have. Maybe you are related to the leader of the southern rebels. "
Ash was a little confused. White hair and red eyes should be very common in this world. How come he is related to the rebel leader? She shrugged, kept her arms around her chest, smiled gently, and said in a calm voice:
"Sir, I don't quite understand what you mean. I'm just an ordinary traveler. I don't know the rebels and leaders you mentioned. "
Just as the man was about to speak, the person on his left took off his hood. A woman with bright golden hair and long ears put down her bow, pulled the hemp rope from the saddle, pulled out a scimitar from her waist, raised her thin eyebrows and walked towards Ash aggressively and said:
"Narsus, there is no need to talk to this foreign woman!
We can't let go of anyone with white hair and red eyes! "
"Wait a moment!
Tweena!
Have you forgotten the difference between us and the rebels? ! "
The leader named Narsus called out coldly to the woman who was about to tie up Ash, and Ash just took the opportunity to see what the woman looked like.
Very boring long platinum hair, draped behind her back like a waterfall until her waist. The end of her long hair was tied into a small ponytail with a green ribbon. Tweena's thin golden eyebrows twitched twice, making her jewel-like green eyes very similar to Narsus.
